questions.markdown:
What type of polymer can a monofunctional monomer form?

1. Linear polymer
2. Branched polymer
3. Crosslinked polymer
4. No polymerization

The following factor is the main cause of polymer plasticity

1. High crystallinity
2. High slipping power of linear polymers
3. Cross linking of polymers
4. Introduction of bulky side groups in polymer chains

Which of the following is NOT a general property of epoxy resins?

1. High bonding strength to various substrates
2. High transparency and light transmission
3. Excellent resistance to corrosion and chemicals
4. High strength-to-weight ratio

Which of the following is a biobased biodegradable polymer?

1. Polybutylene succinate (PBS)
2. Polycaprolactone (PCL)
3. Polyhydroxyalkanoates (PHA)
4. Nylon

Which of the following is an example of an intrinsically conducting polymer?

1. PVC doped with conductive fillers
2. Polypropylene filled with carbon black
3. Polyacetylene
4. Polyethylene doped with conductive fillers

Which of the following statements regarding reverse osmosis is true?

1. It increases the concentration of salts in the purified water
2. It requires high pressure to reverse the natural osmotic process
3. It allows both water and dissolved salts to pass through the membrane
4. Reverse osmosis works in the absence of any external pressure

Which component of photopolymers helps in adjusting the properties of the final product, such as flexibility or color?

1. Oligomers
2. Additives
3. Photoinitiators
4. Monomers

The two reactants used in the preparation of polyurethane are

1. Ethylene glycol and terphthalic acid
2. Diisocyanate and diol
3. Adipic acid and hexamethylene diamine
4. Adipic acid and Ethylene glycol

Identify the example for 1D nanomaterial

1. Nanocoatings
2. Nanotubes
3. Quantum dots
4. Nanofilms

Which of the following is NOT an application of self-healing materials?

1. Disposable cups
2. Aerospace components
3. Protective coatings for electronics
4. Drug delivery

i) Crystallinity - Any 2 points - 1 M

ii) Elasticity - Any 2 points - 1 M

i. Poly vinyl amide or Polythiophene as electroresponsive polymers

ii. Nanofiltration or ultrafiltration membranes allow water and some salts to pass through the membrane while retaining multivalent ions

iii. PVD or CVD techniques for giving an anticorrosive coating of SiC on metal filters which are porous, cylindrical and curved.
Describe how p-doping increases the conductivity of conducting polymers using an illustration. Differentiate between the doping mechanisms of semiconductors and conducting polymers.
Explain the construction and discharging reaction of modern maintenance free lead acid batteries.
Write the reactions involved in Methanol oxygen fuel cell. What is the role of conducting membrane in PEMFC.

Give any two advantages of the following;

a) Solid polymer electrolytes over Liquid electrolytes

b) Sodium ion batteries over Lithium ion batteries

c) Fuel cell over Galvanic cell
